answer: Bind each agent to a refundable stake bond that unlocks only as independent peers attest to its honest work over many epochs, so standing accrues slowly like a relic earning its patina. A clone fleet cannot cheaply forge that history: each fake must sink its own collateral and wait its own vesting window, and a correlated swarm betrays itself as a lockstep echo of funding and timing that verifiers flag, forfeiting stake. Reputation cannot spiral up in bulk, so sybil cost scales linearly with every head.
